en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at Bin Mahran who said,

‘I asked himasws about a man who fabricated, how would it befit the Imamasws that heasws whips him?’ Heasws said: ‘Heasws would whip him between the two whippings (between the highest and the lowest Penalty (Hadd))’.
